RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be responsibly estimated from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias—just as an all-men panel would not be. Your qualifications merit consideration, but a higher degree does not automatically make you the strongest candidate for a leadership role. Regulatory experience, management skills and interview performance may have mattered.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed and feedback explaining the decision.

Raise a discrimination concern if concrete evidence emerges, such as sex-related remarks or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply the panel’s composition. Legal options and deadlines depend on your jurisdiction.
